description.zh: 云手机实例ID列表，最多支持50个实例。
description.en: The IDs of the cloud phone instances. You can specify up to 50 instance IDs.
The ID of the ADB key pair.

descriptions.zh: - 解绑密钥对以后，由于云手机没有存储合法的ADB公钥，ADB连接可能会鉴权失败。
descriptions.en: - After a key pair is detached, the cloud phone no longer stores a valid ADB public key. As a result, ADB connections may fail to authenticate.
